integrity: The lower boundary and unique first layer are established by exhaustive generation of every positive integer composition through total eight, exact symmetry reduction, and exact rational comparison of every admissible ranking pair. The scaled recurrence follows algebraically from homogeneity.
scientific_limitations: The sharp boundary assumes equal census totals, a common species set, and strictly positive integer abundance for every species in every community. It concerns observed Bray–Curtis and Morisita–Horn similarities, not sampling-bias-corrected estimators or unequal-sampling designs.
title: Eight individuals per community are the sharp Bray–Curtis–Morisita–Horn reversal boundary
